Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human mTOR kinase. Join molecule_dictionary to target_dictionary via activities and assays, filtering by target name 'mTOR' and organism 'Homo sapiens' and standard_type 'IC50'. Join compound_records and docs to activities to acquire publication provenance (pubmed_id, doi). Join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary to acquire canonical_smiles. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
